vxea7txh.baseName: Christmas Tree World 9ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
vxea7txh.variantName: Christmas Tree World 9ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
vxea7txh.sourceDescription: Enjoy a festive glow with the 9ft Pre-lit Wildhorn Pine. This beautifully full artificial Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 720 multi-function warm white LED lights, creating an impressive centrepiece for your Christmas celebrations. Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. There is plenty of foliage to showcase your favourite decorations. It has gently upswept branches and a classic, tapered shape, with natural green shades and subtle brown detailing. At 9ft tall, it makes a striking feature in rooms with high ceilings and spacious entrance halls. Warm white LEDs highlight the needles, with multiple lighting effects to suit your display. The tree comes in four sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. Spread inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 9ft • Pre-lit: 720 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 2,818 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree width: 142cm diameter • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches and four tree sections • Base: Metal stand measuring 75cm in diameter • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Indoor use only • Guarantee: 10 years on foliage and branches, plus 1 year on the lights • Supplied in two cartons • Carton 1: 125cm × 38cm × 40cm; weight: 15.15kg • Carton 2: 120cm × 30cm × 30cm; weight: 17.7kg • Combined carton weight: 32.85kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

q0w2b9ca.baseName: Christmas Tree World 5ft Pre-Lit And Decorated Flocked Pop-Up Christmas Tree
q0w2b9ca.variantName: Christmas Tree World 5ft Pre-Lit And Decorated Flocked Pop-Up Christmas Tree
q0w2b9ca.sourceDescription: Create a beautifully finished Christmas display without spending hours assembling, lighting and decorating your tree. The 5ft Pre-lit & Decorated Flocked Pop-up Tree combines snowy foliage, warm white lights and traditional decorations in one clever, easy-to-use design. The rich green foliage is covered with a generous layer of snow-effect flocking, creating the appearance of a freshly snow-covered Christmas tree. It's already decorated with a coordinated selection of red and white baubles and traditional tartan bows, giving you a classic festive look straight out of the box. With 100 warm white LED lights already arranged throughout the foliage, the tree produces a soft and welcoming Christmas glow. The LEDs are static and remain steadily illuminated, beautifully complementing the traditional decorations and snowy finish. Its clever pop-up construction makes setting up your Christmas display quick and straightforward, while the slim 55cm maximum width provides plenty of festive impact without requiring the floor space of a conventional full-width Christmas tree. At 5ft tall, it's a versatile choice for living spaces, hallways, offices and other areas where you want a complete pre-lit and pre-decorated Christmas display with a fraction of the usual effort. Product Features • 5ft pre-lit and decorated pop-up Christmas tree • Snow-flocked green foliage • Pre-decorated with red and white baubles • Traditional tartan bows • Pre-lit with 100 warm white LED lights • Static / steady-on illumination • Slim 55cm maximum width • Quick and convenient pop-up design • 45cm diameter plastic stand • Ideal for spaces where a slim Christmas tree is preferred • 10 year branch and foliage guarantee • 1 year electrical guarantee • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

pj6mxhqr.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Bulbs Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 150 cm
pj6mxhqr.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Bulbs Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 150 cm
pj6mxhqr.sourceDescription: This Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree with LED Light brings the festive joy directly to your home or outside area. Its trendy cone shape is all about elegance and simplicity, making it the perfect focal point for your indoor or outdoor holiday decorations. With warm LED lights creating a lovely ambiance, this tree turns your living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland while keeping things stylish and minimalist. Whether it’s for parties or quiet evenings in, its gentle glow and modern look will fit right in. Complete Set: The Artificial Pre-lit Christmas Tree comes with beautiful warm white LED decorative string lights that give you a heartwarming festive glow. These energy-efficient lights sparkle without the hassle of tangling wires, so you can set up quickly and easily. Durability and Style: Made with PVC, this tree is UV resistant, keeping its vibrant look during the holiday season even in the sun. The strong steel frame makes it sturdy while the modern, cone shape blends well with today’s home decor. Versatile Placement: Great for both indoor and outdoor use, this tree can be the star of your living room or add charm to your garden or terrace. Its good looks and practical design make it easy to fit into various settings, boosting the Christmas spirit wherever it goes. Efficient Power Options: With its USB-powered lights, this tree offers convenience by connecting to any power source with a standard 5V USB connector (not included). You can easily place the tree wherever it looks best. Assembly and Care: Two people are needed for assembly, just follow the manufacturer’s instructions to set it up without a hitch. Looking after your tree is a piece of cake, so it stays a treasured part of your holiday celebrations for years to come. Product Specifications Colour: Black Material: PVC Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 95 cm Stand size: 35 cm Durable Lifelike branch tips Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 1500 cm Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Cable length: 2000 cm Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x stand 1 x LED string This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

v0pc4ndw.baseName: Charles Bentley 12 Piece Glass Christmas Bauble Set - Blue
v0pc4ndw.variantName: Charles Bentley 12 Piece Glass Christmas Bauble Set - Blue
v0pc4ndw.sourceDescription: This 12-piece blue glass bauble set brings a cohesive, colour-led look to any Christmas tree. The set includes four distinctive designs – plain round baubles, ribbed round baubles, textured pinecone baubles, and elongated ice drop baubles, giving your tree a layered, styled finish that a single-shape set simply can't achieve. The blue glass catches the light across four different surfaces: textured shapes catch the light and sparkle. The plain rounds give a gentler shine, so the tree doesn't look busy. The tinted blue shifts between deep sapphire and lighter azure depending on how the light hits. Each bauble is finished with a ribbon hanger for easy, fuss-free hanging. The mixed designs add real visual interest at different levels of the tree, rounds at the tips, pinecones mid-branch, ice drops on longer branches for maximum movement and sparkle. Sold as a set of 12 with ribbon hangers included. Ideal for: Blue and silver Christmas tree themes, contemporary and Scandinavian-inspired Christmas styling, and mixed-design tree displays. Please Note: Glass – handle with care. Keep out of reach of young children. Store in original packaging between seasons to prevent breakage. Features: • Four distinctive designs – plain round ribbed round pinecone and ice drop • Blue glass across smooth ribbed and textured surfaces – each design catches the light differently • A cohesive set of 12 that makes an immediate impact – ideal for contemporary Christmas colour schemes • Glass construction with a refined glistening finish • Ribbon hangers included • Set of 12 across four designs • Hanger type: Ribbon (included) • Care: Wipe with a damp cloth – do not submerge Includes: • 3x plain round baubles • 3x ribbed round baubles • 3x pinecone baubles • 3x ice drop baubles Materials: • Glass Dimensions: • Round: H8 x D8 x W8cm • Pinecone: H9.7 x D7.7 x W7.7cm • Ice drop: H13.2 x D6.3 x W6.3cm • Ribbon hangers pre-attached Weights: • 0.55kg (set of 12) Colours: • Blue Additional Info: • Styling: Mix the four designs across different branch depths – hang ice drops on longer inner branches for movement ribbed rounds and pinecones mid-tree for texture and plain rounds at the branch tips. Pairs well with silver white and gold accents. • Glass: Blue glass. The ribbed and textured finishes catch the light differently to the plain rounds giving each bauble a distinct appearance on the tree. • Care: Wipe with a damp cloth. Do not submerge in water. Handle with care. Dimensions: H8, W8, D8cm Warning: fragile glass - handle with care. Broken glass can cause cuts; discard damaged ornaments safely. Keep out of reach of young children and pets. This is a decoration, not a toy. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ

zh1b177m.variantName: The Christmas Workshop Eucalyptus & Red Berry Garland – 180cm
zh1b177m.sourceDescription: Bring a fresh foliage look to your festive display with this artificial eucalyptus and red berry garland. Detailed leaves and red berry clusters add colour and texture, whether you’re dressing a mantelpiece or framing a doorway. Measuring approximately 180cm long, the garland gives you plenty of scope to drape it along shelves, arrange it around windows or decorate a staircase. The natural-looking artificial foliage creates a seasonal display without the watering or shedding associated with fresh greenery. Suitable for indoor use and covered outdoor areas, it’s easy to work into different spaces around your home. The durable, reusable design requires no special care and can be stored after the festivities, ready for next Christmas. Key Features Artificial eucalyptus foliage and red berry clusters add festive colour and texture. Natural-looking greenery requires no watering or special care. 180cm length for decorating mantelpieces, stairways, shelves and doorways. Suitable for indoor use and covered outdoor areas.
